plan.goal: Implement the frozen role-bound replica scope plus canonical full-snapshot capture and preflighted apply.
acceptance: Add ScopeRole, ReplicaScope<TWorld>, Replicator<TWorld>, CaptureResult and ApplyResult with the exact ownership and result semantics in the frozen contract.
Extend retained generic invokers for allocation-conscious capture, semantic validation, typed creation, phased apply, removal and disable normalization without runtime reflection or boxing.
Validate pre-existing exact Self/Other chunks without registration/adoption and maintain an exact per-session replica GID ledger.
Capture canonical ReplicatedTag entities and records; reject unsupported disabled noncomponents and missing same-snapshot relation targets.
Complete all deterministic schema/scope/GID/segment/occupant/target preflight before any mutation, then apply in the frozen hook-safe order.
Add focused dedicated-world tests for success, canonical bytes, isolation/despawn, every required no-mutation failure, disabled behavior, replacement and hook exception propagation.

riskToTest.risk: Invalid or foreign snapshot state mutates the client world
riskToTest.test: World fingerprint remains identical for every returned preflight failure

riskToTest.risk: Full snapshot despawn crosses session boundaries
riskToTest.test: Two scopes/foreign occupants prove only exact ledger GIDs are updated or removed

riskToTest.risk: Capture order or relation targets are nondeterministic
riskToTest.test: Canonical golden bytes across insertion/query orders and same-snapshot target validation

riskToTest.risk: Entity slot reuse corrupts an existing segment
riskToTest.test: Different-version ledger replacement succeeds only when old GID is missing; surviving/foreign occupant conflicts
